scope_boundaries: Separate developer processing, known preset service integrations and user-selected arbitrary endpoints.
Apple requires accurate disclosure of actual collection by the developer and third-party partners; reviewed guidance does not explicitly classify every arbitrary BYOK endpoint.
Do not require an exhaustive survey of every possible user-configured server before preparing supported answers.
Do not promise zero retention, zero training or no tracking for unknown endpoints, and do not invent collection by them.
Resolve material uncertainty about applicable recipients or a particular field using relevant policies or an architecture-specific App Review clarification.
A conditional data category does not block preparation of unrelated, evidence-backed answers.
not_prerequisites: Exhaustively auditing every server any future user might configure
Removing all online functionality solely because it uses BYOK
Adding every hypothetical data type that might appear in a user document
Treating all network connections as retained location, diagnostic or tracking data
Choosing a DSA trader status or legal age declaration from code alone
